convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iWPR indicator with simple cloud/zone entry logic and fixed SL/TP. No external libraries, no custom indicators, no complex money management.

derived_values.name: WPR value normalized to 0-100 range or cloud zone

other_exits: WPR cloud zone exit - close when WPR enters neutral cloud zone between overbought and oversold levels

custom_logic_notes: WPR Cloud Simple uses Williams Percent Range with a cloud/zone visualization approach. The 'cloud' represents a neutral zone (typically -50 area) where no signal is generated. Long signals occur when WPR exits oversold zone upward; short signals when WPR exits overbought zone downward. Positions may also close when WPR re-enters the neutral cloud zone. SL/TP values are adjusted by multiplying by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001 to account for 5-digit broker pricing.
python_conversion_notes: Use ta-lib or pandas-ta WPR function (willr). WPR in MT5 ranges -100 to 0; in most Python libraries it ranges 0 to -100. Ensure level comparisons are consistent. Digit adjustment for SL/TP must be replicated: if symbol has 5 digits, multiply pip-based SL/TP by 10. New bar detection can use Pandas resample or timestamp comparison. The cloud zone logic is simply a range check on the WPR value between overbought and oversold thresholds.
